Country and location: China, Sichuan, 45 km (28 mi) west of Linqiong
Kuwait, Al Ahmadi, 25 km (16 mi) south southwest of Al Ahmadi
Notes: It is the strongest earthquake to hit Kuwait in the last 30 years. There were reports of damage to some buildings.

Country and location: Tonga, Vavaʻu offshore, 126 km (78 mi) northwest of Neiafu
Australia, Tasmania offshore, 1,617 km (1,005 mi) south of Geeveston
United States, Alaska offshore, Rat Islands, 347 km (216 mi) west of Adak
Brazil, Acre, 111 km (69 mi) south southwest of Tarauacá
Indonesia, West Sulawesi offshore, 40 km (25 mi) west southwest of Mamuju
Notes: At least 259 buildings, including a mosque and an office building, were damaged in Mamuju and Majene, some of which were completely destroyed. Seventeen people were injured.

Country and location: China, Sichuan, 254 km (158 mi) northwest of Tianpeng
Notes: At least 492 houses were damaged in Hongyuan County, along with several bridges. Power outages also occurred. Six people were injured and 25,790 were evacuated.

Country and location: Turkey, Van, 29 km (18 mi) northeast of Van
Notes: One house collapsed and twenty others were damaged in Erciş and Van.

Country and location: Iran, Hormozgan offshore, 21 km (13 mi) northeast of Kish
Notes: Cracks appeared in around 20 buildings in Bandar Charak, and four people were injured.

Country and location: United States, Georgia, 7 km (4.3 mi) east of Stillmore
Notes: It is the largest earthquake to hit the state since 2014. On Hutchinson Island, the earthquake caused land to slump into the Savannah River, seriously damaging the parking garage of a dock situated above.

Country and location: Japan, Ishikawa, 61 km (38 mi) north northeast of Nanao
Notes: Damage was observed in Suzu, where items fell off shelves, windows were shattered, and a stone torii gate and the walls of a temple collapsed. At least seven people were injured.

Country and location: Afghanistan, Paktika, 51 km (32 mi) southwest of Khost
Mexico, Jalisco, 1 km (0.62 mi) west of Ciudad Guzmán
Notes: At least 102 houses were damaged, 22 of which were uninhabitable. Over 138 people were affected and 33 were left homeless.

Country and location: Nepal, Gandaki, 14 km (8.7 mi) east southeast of Chitre
Notes: A teenager was injured when a house collapsed in Pokhara.

Country and location: Pakistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, 49 km (30 mi) west of Miran Shah
Notes: Aftershock of the June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake three days earlier. In Gayan District, Afghanistan, five people were killed and eleven were injured.

Country and location: Iran, Hormozgan offshore, 30 km (19 mi) northeast of Kīsh
Notes: One person died from a fall and at least 37 were injured.

Country and location: Algeria, Oran offshore, 13 km (8.1 mi) north northwest of Aïn el Bya
Notes: Some homes in Arzew sustained cracks. Eighty people were injured.

Country and location: Philippines, Cagayan Valley offshore, 49 km (30 mi) north northeast of Namuac
Notes: Some damage was reported in Aparri, where one house collapsed.
